newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares close lower after early uptrend.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares close lower after early uptrend.

text.p: Shares on the Delhi bourse shed early gains to close lower on Tuesday as foreign institutional investors (FIIs) sold stocks amid profit-taking, brokers said.
The Delhi sensitive index closed 1.10 points down at 779.56. It was 2.26 points up in early trade.
"There were very few players in the market in the absence of any encouraging factor," said Suresh Agarwal of brokers Jai Mata Securities.
Reliance Industries ended 0.65 rupee down at 296.65.
Bajaj Auto lost 24.95 rupees to close at 845.05 due to selling by FIIs after the company's announcement of a bonus share issue on Monday, brokers said.
The company's board proposed a one-for-two bonus issue, while the market had expected one bonus share for each share held, brokers said.
